canonical_rule_program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 3) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 9)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))
                                (* (- (obj-h obj) 2) (- (obj-w obj) 2))))
           (all? (lambda (p)
                   (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj))
                       (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                 (obj-cells obj))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))
    (define inners
      (map (lambda (obj)
             (subgrid g (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1)
                      (- (obj-r2 obj) 1) (- (obj-c2 obj) 1)))
           (take frames 3)))
    (define A (first inners))
    (define B (second inners))
    (define C (third inners))
    (define code
      (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? (transform-code A t) B)) (list 1 2 3 4))))
        (if hit hit 1)))
    (transform-code C code)))

teaching.policy: three consecutive demonstrations; fourth pair held out as query
teaching.domain: unmodified ordinary generator outputs with no overrides
